verdict: Split personality. Roughly half the code is genuinely real and competent: nb06's DPO trains on 21 verified-real preference pairs in the repo, nb08/nb13-Â§3's REINFORCE Wordle training is honest end-to-end RL with paired eval, nb09's GRPO recipe is sound, and nb11/nb12 hit real external APIs with sha256-stamped responses. But the flagship 13_MASTER_HACKATHON_FINAL â€” the one README points judges at â€” contains outright fabrication: Â§9's "4-method causal counterfactual" is literally four np.random.normal() draws around hand-picked means (275/250/263/285) relabeled as paired-bootstrap/synthetic-control/ARIMA-BSTS/do-calculus and written to a receipt; Â§1's "269/269 attacks blocked = 100%" is structurally rigged (n_safe increments in BOTH branches, injection strings never even passed to two tools, 19 attacks added as a constant, compliant:True hardcoded in the fallback); Â§5 plots a hardcoded 4-row trajectory and stamps a hardcoded "2735x" into a receipt; Â§7 is a SyntaxError that cannot execute (proof nobody ever ran the notebook top-to-bottom); and the certificate cell's locals().get() hacks silently substitute defaults while the HTML hardcodes the string "= 100%". Every single notebook has zero stored outputs and zero execution counts, so every headline number ("8%â†’100%, p=2.71e-18", "100-step real run on T4") exists only as markdown claims. nb10 clones a GitHub repo that does not exist and its gym wrapper mis-unpacks the env's single-Observation return, so it would crash cell 3 and produce zero-reward episodes even if fixed. nb11's K4 pushes a synthetic linear reward/loss curve to W&B to "close the W&B gap". This is exactly the pattern the owner banned.
